A global industry leader (Nasdaq: PRAA)

With its global headquarters located in Norfolk, Virginia, PRA Group, Inc. is a publicly traded company that has grown to become one of the largest acquirers of nonperforming loans in the world. Its portfolio operations span 18 countries, 12 languages and 12 currencies. Through its subsidiaries, PRA Group returns essential capital to banks and other lenders, helping expand financial services available to consumers and businesses. For 30 years, PRA Group companies have focused on improving their customers’ financial futures, creating fulfilling careers for thousands of employees worldwide and giving back to local communities.
PRA Group went public on November 8, 2002, and has since grown to become one of the largest purchasers of nonperforming loans in the world.

pages.raw_title: About Us - PRA Group • PRA Group
pages.raw_meta: PRA Group delivers nonperforming loan solutions that drive success through a long-term focus and customer care.
raw_blocks: 30 years of redefining the nonperforming loan industry.
Doing things the right way, for the right reasons, with a long-term focus.
To deliver nonperforming loan solutions that drive success through a long-term focus and customer care.
From a single employee to the global footprint of PRA Group and its subsidiaries, our company is built on this mission. It gives purpose to, and is the foundation of, everything we do.
To be the trusted leader, changing the world’s perception of the nonperforming loan industry.
This shared vision fuels our pursuit of redefining the nonperforming loan industry, is our guiding light to the future of PRA Group and sets our bar for success.

In 1996, Steve Fredrickson and Kevin Stevenson had a vision for a professional business in the nonperforming loan industry. With four employees in Norfolk, Virginia, they set out to found a company that would do things differently. Things like helping improve financial futures by taking a customer-first approach, providing affordable and flexible payment options, meeting high levels of compliance and reliability, and creating rewarding careers for employees. They took Portfolio Recovery Associates, Inc. public in November 2002 and changed the parent company name to PRA Group, Inc. in October 2014. Today, PRA Group has grown to become a global leader in the nonperforming loan industry with operations and thousands of employees around the world. Nearly three decades since our founding, we remain focused on doing things the right way, for the right reasons, for the long term.

pages.raw_title: Our Clients - PRA Group • PRA Group
pages.raw_meta: PRA Group delivers nonperforming loan solutions that drive success through a long-term focus and customer care.
raw_blocks: At PRA Group, our clients can trust that we will do things the right way and deliver quality service for their customers once they sell their accounts to us — providing the tools to make debt repayment flexible and affordable.

Through our subsidiaries, our primary business is the purchase, collection and management of nonperforming loan portfolios. We acquire nonperforming credit cards and loans, insolvency accounts, and auto loans. We also offer revenue and recovery services to our business clients.
We purchase nonperforming loans from banks and credit issuers in the Americas, Europe and Australia and collaborate with customers to help them resolve their debt.
We purchase and file securities and antitrust class action claims and provide fee-based recovery services to institutional investors and corporate clients in the U.S. and Europe.

Our business was founded in 1996 as an acquirer and collector of U.S. consumer nonperforming loans. Over time and by design, PRA Group has expanded and diversified to become a global leader in the industry. Through its subsidiaries, PRA Group has portfolio operations in 18 countries around the world.
